title: Supplemental DeliveryProof Free R3 developer QA — Tk user workflow and limited TCP/UDP observations

tk_gui_workflow.details: Actual R3 Tk GUI mainloop and its worker callbacks with original R3 synthetic videos and bundled MediaInfo, but launched from source modules rather than the bundled frozen executable.
tk_gui_workflow.pass: Capture approved baseline, create matching PASS ZIP, decrement isolated trial counter once
tk_gui_workflow.fail: Find mismatching final files, show FAIL and block ZIP without reducing trial count

process_network_idle_observation.technique: Windows netstat -ano TCP/UDP snapshots filtered to the app's own top-level process PID during startup and idle
limitations: Only this target GUI PID was monitored, not every native-library call or descendants.
Snapshots may miss very short-lived connections.
No synthetic-video verification run was performed during this idle observation.
This is not an independent assurance of zero network traffic or telemetry.
Developer-operated synthetic assessment, not independent customer QA or security certification
The GUI source workflow is not the same as an end-to-end mouse-driven test of the frozen EXE
The idle-only process-PID socket snapshots may miss short-lived connections and do not cover descendants, native-library behavior under other workloads, DNS activity, or full packet capture
The local release file hash has not been independently verified against a buyer-hosted Gumroad download
No Windows 11, managed-endpoint or Authenticode validation was performed in this supplemental test.
